## What This Site Covers
- AI voice agent / 24/7 electrician answering service — answers calls in the firm's name, books jobs, qualifies enquiries, routes emergency callouts
- AI chatbot for electricians — website + WhatsApp + Facebook enquiry capture
- Workflow automation — quote follow-ups, booking confirmations, reminders, reviews
- Audience: sole-trader sparkies, domestic electricians, commercial electrical contractors, emergency electricians, EV charger installers, testing & inspection specialists, solar PV installers, multi-van electrical firms
- Service area: United Kingdom

- 24/7 cover including evenings, weekends, bank holidays and overnight

### Service Coverage — UK-wide
We deliver AI voice agents + chatbots + workflow automation to UK electricians and electrical contractors nationally. Discovery calls are free and run for 30 minutes. Most deployments go live within 2-3 weeks.

### Electrical Services the AI Knows
Domestic rewires, consumer-unit upgrades, EICRs and fixed-wire testing, PAT testing, EV charger installations, fire alarm systems, commercial installations, fault-finding, emergency callouts, solar PV.

### Emergency Triage
The AI flags urgent calls (sparking, burning smells, power outage, exposed wiring) and follows the escalation rules you set — text or call you, or attempt live transfer.

### Integrations
- Calendars: Google Calendar, Outlook, Calendly
- Job management: Jobber, ServiceM8, Tradify (others via webhook/email/CSV)
- Notifications: text + email instant summaries after every call
